title: Laghusudarshan Churna
description: Laghusudarshan Churna (Mahasudarshan Churna) is the ultimate bitter antiviral and antipyretic Ayurvedic formulation where Maha indicates comprehensive, maximum-strength variant. This legendary formulation is the primary remedy for all types of fevers including viral, malaria, and typhoid through comprehensive antimicrobial action. Clears toxic liver heat. Cures fatigue accompanying fever. Handles seasonal flu through immune stimulation.
dosage: Mixed with warm water (tastes very bitter)
